message_excerpt: Fixed Action definition missing SUBMIT in OpenAPI
proposition: POST /{scopeId}/devices/{deviceId}/events/_query: contract says event action is restricted to READ, CREATE, WRITE, DELETE, OPTIONS and EXECUTE; implementation does allow and serialize the additional SUBMIT event action without normalization to any listed value
